I've updated the shared knowledge base: Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is now 10 June.

- **What I changed:** I saved Ilse's correction with a note of where it came from, her #north-random message. I also retired the 25 November date she posted in #north-team this morning, so the old date won't come up again.
- **What I told her:** I replied in her #north-random thread to confirm the change.
- **What I left alone:** She said no action was needed, so I didn't post in #north-team or anywhere else. Her original 25 November message is still there for anyone reading that channel.
- **What I couldn't check:** The knowledge base search is keyword-only. A note that gives the renewal date in different words could have been missed. Neither search I ran turned up any other note with the date.
